{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Soccer Ball''' was an enemy part of the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It has low health and normal speed. Additionally, it can also spawn with [[Blessed]], [[Bloated]] and [[Tank]] attributes. ==Appearance== The '''Soccer Ball''' is a soccer ball decorated with green, blue and red stylized shapes around it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} SoccerBallCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} BackyardLegendsPI.png|'''Soccer Ball''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} BackyardLegendsIcon.png|'''Soccer Ball''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} adidas Backyard Legends Trailer ⚽ - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Soccer Ball''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SoccerBallIconIG.png|'''Soccer Ball''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Soccer Ball''' is based on the Adidas ''Trionda'' ball that was used for the FIFA World Cup 2026. *The '''Soccer Ball''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Soccer Ball''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Soccer Ball's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Soccer Ball''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BackyardBeginnings|Start|N/A|Soccer Ball & [[Cleats]]|Wave 1|[[Boombox]]|Wave 3}} {{CompetitionCourt|Start|N/A|Soccer Ball & [[Cleats]]|Wave 1|[[Boombox]]|Wave 3}} {{VictoryField|Start|N/A|Soccer Ball|Wave 1 (Easy)|hardt2 = Soccer Ball & [[Cleats]]|hardw2 = Wave 1 (Hard)|[[Cleats]]|Wave 2 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Boombox]]|hardw3 = Wave 3 (Hard)}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
